This is the same tool-layer boundary recorded in LOOP1E_PHASE_C1_LAUNCH_BLOCKED_RECEIPT.json, not a project gate.
current_blocker.why_i_did_not_bypass_it: the different-PID check is the substance of the G0 protocol - it proves a saved part survives a genuine cold reopen. Editing it to accept the same PID would fabricate the evidence the gate exists to produce.
